scope: Three bounded opt-in native observations for original Doom E1M1; commercial inputs and runtime artifacts remain private.

comparison_landmark.site: same Doom leveltime pre-increment source site
comparison_landmark.outcome: all listed fields matched between origin and fresh-process cold restore

checkpoint.earlier_timer_stop: CPU-frontier differences remained at the 700 ms timer stop while frame and ammo matched; this is not an instruction-budget boundary.

paired_bda_timing.bda_mapping: open; nominal period is not calibrated to observed deltas
paired_bda_timing.equivalence_claim: none; backend-specific clock contracts are not equivalent timing evidence

harness_corrections: Use distinct source-binding export filenames for origin and cold child.
Wait 2000 guest ms after the single Enter before post-load frame and ammo observation.
Remove the stale timing breakpoint before the accepted timing observation.

limits: No general deterministic replay or broad emulator parity claim.
No cross-engine BDA calibration or timing equivalence claim.
No CI, release, merge, or shared installation/activation.
